note: Release trains: the macro units players experience. Projects declare release + release_critical + depends_on; everything else derives. No dates on purpose — this program runs on gates and evidence (the repo's standing rule), so 'schedule risk' renders as blocked critical-path chains and their ages, never as fictional calendar cells.

releases.name: Player Update 1
releases.goal: The first public update since v0.1.0: the rebuilt onboarding players can feel — the cot and stations that present themselves, the clock, the yard as home — shipped with the gate evidence behind it, on the ship-early-and-often ruling.
releases.definition_of_done: M1.5's exit gate closes on the pre-release green-tester session (the one fresh-player pass per public release, ruled 2026-09-02), and a v0.2.0 tag goes out through the deploy runbook.

releases.name: M3 — the next content milestone
releases.goal: The next slice of the five-phase arc, scoped by your ruling and planned on the M2.5 template. What M3 actually contains is itself the opening decision.
releases.definition_of_done: Scope ruled; plan written with a measured exit gate; work items delivered and verified.
